title: Smell test recording table, three pots
subject: Science
unit: Spring 2: The human body and senses (Memory Box and Human Senses)
source: Written for science/y1 lesson 12 (Smell test recording table, three pots (portal printable))
intro: Lesson 12: Touch, taste and smell. A practical to do at home with an adult nearby. Read it all first.

practical.aim: To find out if we can name foods by smell alone
equipment: Three foods with a strong smell (for example orange peel, mint, cinnamon)
A scarf or your hands for covering your eyes
safety: An adult knows what you are doing and is nearby
Clear a space and tidy up afterwards; wash your hands
method: A grown-up puts one food in each pot and does not tell you which
Smell pot 1 and say what you think it is
Smell pots 2 and 3 the same way

questions.q: Big question: could you find an orange with your eyes closed? How?
questions.a: Yes: smell it, feel its bumpy skin, or taste it
